items.title: Derive the DONE-required phase deadline from sequential command budgets
items.context: Replace the unrelated 240-second default for the DONE-required closeout phase with sum(effective ordered command timeouts) plus bounded orchestration grace. Preserve global/per-phase overrides, per-command attribution, cleanup, human/JSON budget source, and a non-repeating timeout hint.

items.title: Reuse structurally fresh DONE-required evidence during done_prepare
items.context: Before spawning done_required_validate, consume canonical freshness/admissibility checks plus metadata-only HEAD lineage. Reuse only a current PASS receipt; expose an independently disableable switch and human/JSON reused/executed/refusal classification. validate:false never manufactures evidence.

items.title: Keep long active DONE-required commands alive without weakening timeout safety
items.context: Bridge direct done_required_validate progress/heartbeat through ctx.log so active silent commands survive the CLI idle watchdog. Preserve command timeoutMs, outer deadline, absolute max, JSON stdout isolation, process-tree cleanup, validation-lock cleanup, and existing idle/max overrides.
